```sql
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN customers c2
        ON c2.id = o.customer_id
       AND c2.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING max(o.created_at) >= %(from)s
       AND max(o.created_at) <  %(to)s
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       t.revenue,
       t.order_count,
       t.last_order_at
  FROM customers c
  JOIN totals t ON t.customer_id = c.id
 ORDER BY t.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De gematerialiseerde CTE met alle orders van alle tenants verdwijnt. De aparte `DISTINCT ON`-sortering wordt vervangen door `max(created_at)` in dezelfde aggregatie; dat is equivalent omdat `created_at` NOT NULL is. De tenantfilter op `customers` wordt vóór de aggregatie toegepast, zodat alleen orders van klanten van deze tenant worden geaggregeerd, en het tijdvenster wordt als `HAVING` op die aggregatie toegepast.
